enetcv_fold_blocks.note: Arm value = chunks per fold (fixed constant, not a data shape). Every row read once per pass (vs F+1 full scans), TwoSum/Dot2 compensated chunk partials, chunks merged ascending, training sets by parallel-axis rule over folds ascending. Each arm is its own bits version; NV and AMD must match per arm. NOT COMPILED-VERIFIED on host (lanes no longer compile); sm_90 device binding compiled rc=0 with =32 before the rule change.
